title: Meta Ads Update: Ads on Threads
description: Meta Ads Update: Ads on Threads
transcript: I've got some big news when it comes to ads on threads. So previously, ads on threads were only shown in the US, but they've now been rolled out globally. So if you're not based in the US, you are likely to start seeing ads on threads shortly. We've also now got more ad formats that we can use on that platform. So instead of basic feed ads, we can now also run carousel ads, catalog ads, app ads. So we've got more flexibility as advertisers to reach the more than 400 million monthly active users currently on threads.
